281354330.description: This collection includes four briar wood tobacco pipes featuring brands such as Yello-Bole and Zodiac Scorpio, along with an unmarked Danish pipe with a bone-colored stem. The pipes come in various bowl shapes including bulldog, billiard, and bent, with brown and reddish-brown tones and dark vulcanite or bakelite stems, some accented with metal ferrules. Included are two wooden display stands: a 3-hole oak pedestal stand and a 2-slot wooden stand, each with carved pipe rests and ashtray-style trays. The items show signs of age with patina and residue inside the bowls consistent with vintage estate pipes.

281108342.description: This polished pink calcite crystal obelisk features a soft pale pink color with subtle white banding throughout. The surface has a smooth finish and the piece stands approximately 6 inches tall. The base includes a label identifying the material as pink calcite. It is suitable as a decorative mineral specimen and has been well maintained.

281994989.description:
Vintage Marble Ceramic Ashtray Set with Two Wooden Tobacco Pipes Pre-Owned
This vintage set includes a large ceramic ashtray with a marble pattern in white, gray, and black. The ashtray features a glossy finish and three grooves designed for resting pipes or cigars. Accompanying the ashtray are two wooden tobacco pipes with dark brown bowls and black stems. One pipe has a silver band near the stem. Both pipes show signs of prior use and wear. No visible brand or model markings are present. The set reflects mid-century or classic design craftsmanship, suitable for collectors or enthusiasts.
